title: First-Touch Support Validation
short_description: Apply first-touch support validation to objective market analysis, chart interpretation, and risk-controlled execution.

short_description_i18n.en: Apply first-touch support validation to objective market analysis, chart interpretation, and risk-controlled execution.
short_description_i18n.zh: 将首次触及支撑验证应用于客观市场分析、图表判断及风险受控的执行。

learning_objectives: Explain the decision rules for First-Touch Support Validation.
Identify valid and invalid evidence for First-Touch Support Validation.
Build a risk-controlled order plan using First-Touch Support Validation.
learning_objectives_i18n: 说明首次触及支撑验证的决策规则。

instructions: Complete all five questions. Questions 4 and 5 require original written analysis and screenshot evidence from a demo, replay, or historical environment.

instructions_i18n.en: Complete all five questions. Questions 4 and 5 require original written analysis and screenshot evidence from a demo, replay, or historical environment.

questions.title: Question 1
questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates first-touch support validation?

question_text_i18n.en: Which method most reliably evaluates first-touch support validation?
question_text_i18n.zh: 哪一种方法最可靠地评估首次触及支撑验证？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for First-Touch Support Validation.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate First-Touch Support Validation.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate First-Touch Support Validation.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估首次触及支撑验证。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a first-touch support validation thesis is invalidated?

question_text_i18n.en: Which response best protects the trader when a first-touch support validation thesis is invalidated?
question_text_i18n.zh: 当首次触及支撑验证的交易论点失效时，哪一种做法最能保护交易者？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for First-Touch Support Validation.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when First-Touch Support Validation no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when First-Touch Support Validation no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在首次触及支撑验证不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates dynamic resistance in a downtrend?

question_text_i18n.en: Which method most reliably evaluates dynamic resistance in a downtrend?

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估下降趋势中的动态阻力。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a dynamic resistance in a downtrend thesis is invalidated?

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Dynamic Resistance in a Downtrend no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在下降趋势中的动态阻力不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

learning_objectives: Explain the decision rules for Protected Highs and Protected Lows.
Identify valid and invalid evidence for Protected Highs and Protected Lows.

instructions: Complete all five questions. Questions 4 and 5 require original written analysis and screenshot evidence from a demo, replay, or historical environment.

instructions_i18n.en: Complete all five questions. Questions 4 and 5 require original written analysis and screenshot evidence from a demo, replay, or historical environment.

questions.title: Question 1
questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates protected highs and protected lows?

question_text_i18n.en: Which method most reliably evaluates protected highs and protected lows?
question_text_i18n.zh: 哪一种方法最可靠地评估受保护高点与低点？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Protected Highs and Protected Lows.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Protected Highs and Protected Lows.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Protected Highs and Protected Lows.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估受保护高点与低点。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a protected highs and protected lows thesis is invalidated?

question_text_i18n.en: Which response best protects the trader when a protected highs and protected lows thesis is invalidated?
question_text_i18n.zh: 当受保护高点与低点的交易论点失效时，哪一种做法最能保护交易者？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Protected Highs and Protected Lows.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Protected Highs and Protected Lows no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Protected Highs and Protected Lows no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在受保护高点与低点不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.title: Question 1
questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates range expansion breakout?

question_text_i18n.en: Which method most reliably evaluates range expansion breakout?
question_text_i18n.zh: 哪一种方法最可靠地评估区间扩张突破？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Range Expansion Breakout.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Range Expansion Breakout.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Range Expansion Breakout.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估区间扩张突破。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a range expansion breakout thesis is invalidated?

question_text_i18n.en: Which response best protects the trader when a range expansion breakout thesis is invalidated?
question_text_i18n.zh: 当区间扩张突破的交易论点失效时，哪一种做法最能保护交易者？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Range Expansion Breakout.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Range Expansion Breakout no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Range Expansion Breakout no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在区间扩张突破不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Closing Price Confirmation.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Closing Price Confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Closing Price Confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估收盘价确认。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Closing Price Confirmation no longer holds.

text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在收盘价确认不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Consecutive-Loss Stop Rule.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Consecutive-Loss Stop Rule.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Consecutive-Loss Stop Rule.

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Trailing Stop Structure Logic.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Trailing Stop Structure Logic.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Trailing Stop Structure Logic.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估结构化移动止损逻辑。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a trailing stop structure logic thesis is invalidated?

question_text_i18n.en: Which response best protects the trader when a trailing stop structure logic thesis is invalidated?
question_text_i18n.zh: 当结构化移动止损逻辑的交易论点失效时，哪一种做法最能保护交易者？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Trailing Stop Structure Logic.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Trailing Stop Structure Logic no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Trailing Stop Structure Logic no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在结构化移动止损逻辑不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates order cancellation after invalidation?

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Order Cancellation After Invalidation.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Order Cancellation After Invalidation.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Order Cancellation After Invalidation.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估失效后撤销订单。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a order cancellation after invalidation thesis is invalidated?

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Order Cancellation After Invalidation.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Order Cancellation After Invalidation no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Order Cancellation After Invalidation no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在失效后撤销订单不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Revenge-Trading Prevention.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a revenge-trading prevention thesis is invalidated?

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Revenge-Trading Prevention.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Revenge-Trading Prevention no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Revenge-Trading Prevention no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在报复性交易预防不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Loss Acceptance and Reset.

questions.title: Question 1
questions.question_text: Which method most reliably evaluates top-down structure mapping?

question_text_i18n.en: Which method most reliably evaluates top-down structure mapping?
question_text_i18n.zh: 哪一种方法最可靠地评估自上而下结构映射？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Explain the decision rules for Top-Down Structure Mapping.

answer_options.text: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Top-Down Structure Mapping.

text_i18n.en: Use objective structure, repeated price response, and a defined invalidation to evaluate Top-Down Structure Mapping.
text_i18n.zh: 使用客观结构、重复价格反应及明确失效条件评估自上而下结构映射。

answer_options.text: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.

text_i18n.en: Use only the colour of the most recent candle.
text_i18n.zh: 只使用最近一根K线的颜色。

answer_options.text: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.

text_i18n.en: Assume every first touch will reverse without confirmation.
text_i18n.zh: 假设每次首次触及都会无条件反转。

answer_options.text: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.

text_i18n.en: Choose the conclusion that allows the largest position size.
text_i18n.zh: 选择能使用最大仓位的结论。

questions.title: Question 2
questions.question_text: Which response best protects the trader when a top-down structure mapping thesis is invalidated?

question_text_i18n.en: Which response best protects the trader when a top-down structure mapping thesis is invalidated?
question_text_i18n.zh: 当自上而下结构映射的交易论点失效时，哪一种做法最能保护交易者？

questions.instructions: Select the best answer.

instructions_i18n.en: Select the best answer.
instructions_i18n.zh: 选择最佳答案。

questions.learning_objective: Identify valid and invalid evidence for Top-Down Structure Mapping.

answer_options.text: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Top-Down Structure Mapping no longer holds.

text_i18n.en: Define the invalidation first and reject the idea when Top-Down Structure Mapping no longer holds.
text_i18n.zh: 先定义失效条件，并在自上而下结构映射不再成立时放弃交易。

answer_options.text: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.

text_i18n.en: Widen the stop after entry so the original idea cannot fail.
text_i18n.zh: 入场后扩大止损，使原计划不会失败。

answer_options.text: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.

text_i18n.en: Ignore the higher timeframe whenever the lower timeframe moves quickly.
text_i18n.zh: 低周期快速波动时忽略高周期。

answer_options.text: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.

text_i18n.en: Increase position size after a loss to recover faster.
text_i18n.zh: 亏损后增加仓位以更快回本。
